name: Glorious | Banapple Phone
description: You'll feel the heady effects almost immediately, lifting your mind into a state of happy euphoria that's accompanied by a boost of creativity. As you find your mind wandering through artistic ideas and visions, a deeply relaxing tingle will begin to work its way throughout your entire body. This buzzing effect can turn stimulating and arousing at times, too.
